features.note: Counter-rotation still reads cleanly at 30%: the drive blade presents its bright up-swept face while the top blade shows a dark counter-tilted underside and the bottom blade tilts opposite again — never parallel. The attempt-1 failure (thin single-curved sheet) is corrected: the drive blade now carries a rounded seal-capped leading edge and visible center thickness that tapers toward the trailing edge at the exposed far end, with a graduated thin rim along the lit lower edge — a double-skin airfoil section reads. Caveats keeping this at 0.82: the near end is occluded by the frame post and the two dark blades' sections are lost in shadow, so the airfoil read rests mostly on the drive blade's far end.

Plated cylindrical stub protrudes from a collar on the frame right face with a clearly free spindle length (~40-50 mm at scale) before the dark clamp plate; the beveled orange body hangs offset on the shaft, never flush on the frame. The clamp plate now shows a slot with a plated bolt, and the anti-rotation strap is unambiguous: a dark strap descends from the actuator and lands a flat foot on the frame right face with a legible hex anchor bolt and washer. Improved over attempt 1 on both strap legibility and clamp read.

Crisp light cylindrical disc with a bold dark pointer sits on the actuator head on the shaft axis at the pointed position consistent with 30% travel. Printed 0-90 arc remains absent — deferred to the materials pass per gate scope, not penalized; 1:1 rotation is unverifiable from a still. No regression from attempt 1.

No regression: channel frame reads with real ~0.13 m depth against the 0.60 m face, flange rings on both faces with discrete fastener heads (front ring plus rear flange edge visible along the top-back), and visible wall thickness at the interior opening. Proportions match 600x400x127.

The attempt-1 flat slab is gone: the left side now shows a discrete articulated assembly — a cylindrical vertical jackrod proud of the flange, three crank/slider blocks with pin and nut studs, diagonal crank arms reaching toward three axle-end studs on the frame face, and clearly UNEQUAL block spacing along the rod (tight pair up top, long run to the bottom block) that betrays articulation rather than a rigid bar. Everything silhouettes at azimuth 42. Held below 0.80 because kinematic coherence is approximate rather than verifiable: the top two crank arms read with similar tilt where blades 1 and 2 have opposite signs, and the blade-1 joint sits below its axle stud while same-sign blade-3's joint sits roughly level — same-sign cranks should mirror each other, not diverge.

important_features.note: Clear improvement: black rounded EPDM bulbs now read as discrete parts along the blade long edges — unmistakable on the drive blade's top edge and legible on the lower blades' edges. Jamb seals at the frame interior side faces remain ambiguous with shadow (a dark vertical band that could be either seal or shade).
Clean light rectangular label plate on the orange body's front face at plausible label proportions; printed spec text remains a materials-pass item. Unchanged from attempt 1.

Corrected: the dark cable now exits below the actuator and droops to the LEFT of the CONTROL DE EQUIPO panel with a verifiable catenary bend down to the ground plane — no longer hidden behind the UI. It is dim against the dark floor but the curve, not a straight rod, is legible.

defects: Side-linkage kinematic coherence is approximate: the top two crank arms tilt similarly although blades 1 and 2 counter-rotate, and the blade-1 rod joint sits below its axle stud while same-sign blade-3's joint sits roughly level — same-sign cranks should mirror.
Airfoil section thickness is only verifiable at the drive blade's far end; the near end is occluded by the frame post and the two dark blades' sections are lost in shadow.
Jamb seals on the frame interior side faces still do not separate from shadow — only the blade-edge bulbs read as parts.
A faint dashed diagonal line artifact crosses near the frame's lower-right corner against the floor (near the strap foot) — reads as a stray helper/edge line, not a part.
Printed 0-90 indicator arc absent (deferred to materials pass — recorded, not penalized).
corrections: Mirror the crank-arm tilts by blade sign: blades 1 and 3 (+theta) cranks must share the same arm angle and rod-joint offset direction, with blade 2 (-theta) opposed — recompute joint positions from the actual blade angle so the linkage is kinematically coherent at any apertura.
Remove the stray dashed line geometry visible near the frame's lower-right corner.
Lift the jamb seal strips a few millimeters proud of the frame interior side faces (or lighten the interior shadow) so they separate from shade and read as parts.
